summary: Diff adds Tailoring subcategories (including "Blouse Stitching" and saree-related options) to the backend taxonomy, enhances frontend taxonomy fallbacks and subcategory dropdown UX behavior, and standardizes icon rendering via SafeIconImage using a local SVG fallback. However, the diff does not include the requested SVG icon assets themselves, and it appears to introduce a /blog route not required for the requested dropdown/icon/auth changes.

missing_requirements.reason: No new files were added in the diff, so the explicitly required SVG assets are not evidenced as being added/updated in frontend/public/assets/generated/*.

hallucinated_features.reason: BuildRequest explicitly constrained changes to avoid adding new pages/routes beyond what is necessary for tailoring dropdowns, icon fixes, and anonymous worker registration; a blog route is not part of those requirements.
